title: Pip and the Cock-a-Doodle Mix-Up
moral: When a friend feels poorly, a little kindness helps them feel better.
description: Rosie the rooster has a sore throat and can't sing her wake-up song! Pip is sure he knows ALL the animal sounds... but his cock-a-doodle comes out as a MOO and an OINK! Learn what cows, pigs, sheep, ducks, hens and roosters say in this funny, kind animated story for kids aged 3 to 8.
intro: Hi friends! Welcome to Little Lantern Stories! Today's story is... Pip and the Cock-a-Doodle Mix-Up!

narration.text: Guess what, friends? Every single morning at Sunny Meadow Farm, Rosie the rooster sings the wake-up song. Cock-a-doodle-DOO!
But today, Rosie opened her beak and out came... squeak. A teeny, tiny squeak! Uh-oh. Rosie had a sore throat.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Oh no, poor Rosie! Don't worry. Tumble and I will wake up the whole farm for you!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Um, Pip... what sound does a rooster make?

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Easy-peasy! I know ALL the animal sounds! Super-duper!

narration.text: Pip hopped up onto a big, scratchy hay bale. BOING! He puffed up his chest and shouted...

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Cock-a-doodle... MOOOOO!
Hee hee! Pip, that's not a rooster sound! Which animal says moo?
A cow! You got it! The cow says MOO! And Daisy the cow mooed right back. Moo, moo, MOO!
Pip laughed so much, he slid right off the hay bale. Wheeeee... flump!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Hee hee! Oopsie-trunk! Try again, Pip!

narration.text: Then Nana Hoot came flapping along to help. Her round glasses slid down, down, DOWN her beak.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Good morning, Rosie dear! My, what a big, fluffy coat you have today!
Hee hee! Nana, that's not Rosie. That's a sheep!
And the sheep said... BAA! The sheep says baa!
Then the ducks on the pond joined in. QUACK, QUACK! The duck says quack!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! Silly old glasses!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Before we wake the farm, let's help Rosie feel better. A sore throat needs rest and kindness.
So Pip made Rosie a soft, cosy hay nest. Nana gave her a snuggly purple scarf. And Tumble carried warm water in a bucket.
The hens on the shelf clucked a happy thank-you. Cluck, cluck! The hen says cluck!
But the hay tickled Tumble's trunk... ah... ah... AH-CHOO!
WHOOSH! Hay flew everywhere, and a big floppy pile landed right on Nana's head, like a funny hat!

narration.speaker: pip

A noodle? Hee hee! Let's help Pip. Can YOU say it with me? Cock-a-doodle-DOO!
Great job! Now everybody, all together! One... two... three...
COCK-A-DOODLE-DOOOO! And Tumble added the biggest trunk HONK ever!

And what does a duck say?
QUACK! Hooray! You're animal sound super stars!

narration.text: The very next morning, Rosie hopped up onto her fence post. Her throat felt all better!
She fluffed up her feathers and sang... COCK-A-DOODLE-DOOOO!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo! I'm awake! I'm awake!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Rosie, you sound super-duper! We missed your song!
Rosie gave her kind friends a big, feathery hug. Because a little kindness is the best wake-up song of all.
